name: Familiar
long_description:
Dubbing is finally good. And real-time. Lipsync + voice translation. For ads and catalogs, networks and platforms, even broadcasts and live shopping.

We exist to break every barrier to understanding. Familiar is a team from Stanford, Yonsei's Visual Intelligence Lab, and HKUST: PhDs, professors, and researchers who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state-of-the-art in real-time human animation. We build world models for accurate humans -- editing, predicting, understanding -- and teaching machines to do the same
